essence: One may go to hell for a duration corresponding to the number of syllables.
By knowing and reciting the great seed, one may obtain liberation.
One should utter the formula oneself at the vowel's end, including obeisance with the heart and reference to the self.
That which is situated in the first and last syllables serves to increase self-knowledge.
Mantras are associated with male deities, while vidyās are associated with female deities.
